import {NextResponse} from "next/server";import {atlasSessionCookieName} from "@/lib/session";
export async function GET(request:Request){const response=NextResponse.redirect(new URL("/",request.url),303);response.cookies.set(atlasSessionCookieName,"",{httpOnly:true,sameSite:"lax",secure:process.env.NODE_ENV==="production",path:"/",maxAge:0});return response}

import {NextResponse} from "next/server";import {optionalAtlasPrincipal} from "@/lib/session";import {connectedModel} from "@/lib/connected";
export const runtime="nodejs";export async function GET(){const principal=await optionalAtlasPrincipal();if(!principal)return NextResponse.json({message:"Authentication required."},{status:401});const model=await connectedModel(principal);return NextResponse.json({mode:model.mode,workspace:model.workspace,metrics:model.metrics,attention:model.attention,upcoming:model.upcoming,handled:model.handled},{headers:{"cache-control":"no-store"}})}
